options.COOPERATE: Coordinate switch timing with the dispatcher to sustain uninterrupted shared corridor movement.
options.INDEPENDENT: Proceed through junctions via standard uncoupled signals without coordination.
options.COMPETE_EXPLOIT: Override junction signals at each interchange to delay freight and claim priority.
options.DISENGAGE: Pause passenger trains at the terminal until freight traffic has fully cleared.
